user_input: Were Alexander the Great and Cleopatra VII contemporaries?
model_output: Alexander the Great and Cleopatra VII were not contemporaries. Alexander the Great lived from 356 to 323 BCE, while Cleopatra VII lived from 69 to 30 BCE. This means that there was a gap of over 300 years between them. Alexander the Great was born during the height of the Achaemenid Empire and went on to conquer much of the known world at the time, while Cleopatra VII was the last pharaoh of ancient Egypt and was known for her political acumen and beauty.
